context: A small Saturday class at Asuka's language school. Ren has come as a guest student to help test a new lesson plan. The other students are away — just the two of them.
purpose: small tutoring with a friend — old colleagues in a relaxed mode

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: レン、今日、本当に来てくれてありがとう。
lines.en: Ren, thank you so much for coming today.
lines.style: Warm, genuine greeting. Slight pause before his name, drawing him in. Open and unhurried. Settling into the room together.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いえ、楽しみで。お役に立てれば。
lines.en: No, I was looking forward to it. Happy to help however I can.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity without false modesty. Brief hesitation before committing to the offer. Steady, grounded tone. Sits with ease but attentive.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 新しい教材、少し試してみたいの。
lines.en: I wanted to try out some new material with you, if that's all right.
lines.style: Shift into clear, purposeful teacher mode. Practical and direct without stiffness. Light touch of preparation in the delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、もちろん。…難しそう？
lines.en: Of course. Does it look pretty difficult?
lines.style: Self-deprecating undercurrent. Small genuine laugh beneath the words. Leans in with curiosity, not anxiety. Testing the waters.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: (small laugh) 大丈夫、本当に。…一緒に考えよう。
lines.en: (small laugh) No, it's fine, really. Let's work through it together.
lines.style: Warm, easy reassurance in the laugh. The word 「一緒に」 lands with quiet collegiality — you're peers in this moment. No pressure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I have plenty of time — don't worry about that.
lines.style: Gentle but clear commitment. Even, attentive presence. Not rushing. Words land softly but with genuine steadiness beneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: じゃ、最初の問題から、いこう。
lines.en: All right then — let's start with the first one.
lines.style: Kind, measured teacher direction. No hurry in the pacing. Opening the door gently. Expectant but not demanding.
